= Section page slots
:page-audience: agent
:page-usage-context: template
:description: What belongs in each slot of an interior page. Read this before adding a page. Do not copy a neighbor page's kicker.

Agents invent the wrong field when they copy an existing page. These slots are the contract. A later page that needs a different shape should say so here before it ships.

== Breadcrumb

One trail, left to right: `Home / parent / current`.

* Home and every ancestor are links.
* The current page is text, not a link.
* The slash is a separator between crumbs. It is not part of the Home label, and it does not mean the site root is a parent folder of Home.
* A link that is not an ancestor (Tags on a post, a sibling section) does not sit in the trail.

Use `src/components/Breadcrumb.astro`. Pass every crumb. Omit `href` on the last item.

== Title

The page name. One `h1`.

== Mono line

Related terms for that title: genres, synonyms, the kind of thing the page holds.

The line is nouns of what the person does in that topic, not role titles and not a sentence.

Not a map of the sections rendered below. Not a negation of another page ("not the résumé"). Not a status of the site's migration.

Examples: Blog uses "Essays · notes · ideas". For fun uses "Roasts · jokes · asides".

== Intro

A plain-English description of the page. Say what the page is. Do not tell the reader to choose among doors that the list below already shows.

== List items

The item title is the link to that item. A second action is only for a different destination, such as an archive next to a live site.

== What not to copy

Older pages used a split bar whose link text was `/ Home`, with the current page name parked on the right. That read as if the current page were Home. Do not revive it.
